BINA.name: Binary Option
BINA.definition: Agreement under which a fixed amount is paid out if a specific condition is met at any time during the exercise period. The expiration style is European or American. The binary option has only "payment triggers".

DIGI.name: Digital Option
DIGI.definition: Agreement under which a fixed amount is paid out if a specific condition is met on expiration date. The digital option has only "payment triggers" which may be single or double trigger level.

NOTO.name: No Touch Option
NOTO.definition: Agreement under which a fixed amount is paid unless a specific condition is met. The notouch option has only "no payment triggers" which may be single or double trigger levels.

VANI.name: Vanilla Option
VANI.definition: Contract that provides the buyer the right but not the obligation to buy or sell the underlying currency at a predetermined rate with expiration determined by the expiration style. The expiration style is European, American, Asian or Bermudan.
